primary.SIMULATION_COMPLETION_RATE_in_scope: >= 0.85 (served scene that passes the exact oracle, browser render criteria and, when asked, a correct answer)

slm_recovery.stratum: SLM_REQUIRED = in-scope cases whose deterministic-parser-only dry run on the FROZEN candidate is not LOCAL_PARSE_COMPLETE
slm_recovery.SLM_VERIFIED_SCENE_RATE: >= 0.30 AND >= 5 SLM-provenance verified scenes in the stratum
slm_recovery.justification: /10 measured 0/20 (Wilson upper 0.16). 0.30 with >= 5 scenes is the smallest bar whose Wilson 95% lower bound clears 0.16 at n ~ 15-30, i.e. a recovery that cannot be the /10 rate by chance; it is a recovery bar, not a release bar (release still needs the primary threshold)
slm_recovery.provenance_rule: a scene counts for Model 1 only if route_d.extraction_mode starts with LOCAL_SLM and the response was produced live in this run (no cache, no replay)

visual: every served scene: canvas ink >= 1%, all gold labels visible inside the canvas, 0 console errors, no stale scene
interaction: absolute: every registered orbit/zoom/step operation on every served scene passes (no PASS_WITH_NOTES)
underdetermined: reported separately: CLARIFY (question surfaced in UI) or ILLUSTRATIVE (disclosed); never a 'not supported' message and never a scene claimed unique
performance_scope: this Windows dev host only; fast-path and SLM-path latencies reported separately; no threshold claimed for target hardware
